selection: best validation PSNR (valid split of PanCollection)
train_note: training runs in segments of at most 48 h; continue an interrupted run with the same command plus --resume. The recipe is the method's published one, identical for the three arms.
infer: python scripts/infer.py --method PanFlowNet --arm original --train-set qb --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PanFlowNet/original/qb_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method PanFlowNet --arm original --train-set qb --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PanFlowNet/original/qb_full
runtime_note: stochastic (normalising-flow sampling); torch.manual_seed(0) before each test image reproduces the table PSNR within 0.15 dB.
inference_seed: torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each test image
